slow waltz sway: her whole body leans gently toward the VIEWER'S LEFT with weight on that foot, the other foot lightly pointed, both arms softly out from her sides at hip height with relaxed open hands, head tilted the same way, eyes gently closed, singing softly with lips parted; skirt and cloak hem swing toward the VIEWER'S RIGHT, lagging behind the lean

slow waltz sway: her whole body leans gently toward the VIEWER'S RIGHT with weight on that foot, the other foot lightly pointed, both arms softly out from her sides at hip height with relaxed open hands, head tilted the same way, eyes half open looking toward the viewer's right, singing softly; skirt and cloak hem swing toward the VIEWER'S LEFT, lagging behind the lean

beginning a pirouette turn: she has turned three-quarters AWAY from the viewer toward the VIEWER'S LEFT, rising on the ball of one foot, arms lifted into a rounded open circle, her curls swinging out, the teal cloak and rust skirt flaring outward in a wide bell from the spin, face in profile with a joyful open-mouthed singing smile

mid pirouette seen almost from behind: her back to the viewer, rising on the ball of one foot, arms extended wide to the sides, the teal cloak fanned out fully like a wide circle showing its gold filigree, skirt flared wide, curls flying outward

the emotional chorus climax: facing the viewer three-quarters toward the VIEWER'S RIGHT, both arms opened wide and lifted up and outward, palms up, chest open, chin lifted, eyes looking up and outward with longing, mouth open singing a sustained pleading note, brows raised; cloak spread behind her arms, one foot stepped forward

laughing delightedly while watching a small child dance at her feet on the VIEWER'S LEFT: body turned toward the VIEWER'S LEFT, bending slightly forward at the waist, hands clapping together softly in front of her chest, eyes crinkled with laughter looking DOWN toward the viewer's left, warm open smile

standing still and shy, body three-quarters toward the VIEWER'S LEFT, both hands clasped together at her chest, shoulders slightly raised, head bowed a little, eyes looking up timidly toward the viewer's left, lips closed, uncertain and moved

swaying gently to music for the first time, body leaning softly toward the VIEWER'S RIGHT, one hand lifting the side of her skirt, the other arm floating out low with the sheer sleeve drifting, eyes half closed, a small surprised smile, lips closed; gown train swings toward the viewer's left

humming with closed lips: facing the viewer, chin lifted toward the light, eyes closed, both arms lowered and opened slightly away from her body with palms turned up and forward, the sheer sleeves hanging, peaceful brave expression, a single tear glint on one cheek

turned three-quarters toward the VIEWER'S LEFT, reaching out her hand on the viewer's left side toward someone, open palm, eyes open and glistening, a soft grateful smile, lips closed, leaning slightly forward

the two women face each other in three-quarter profile: the curly-haired woman stands on the VIEWER'S LEFT, the silver-haired woman on the VIEWER'S RIGHT. The curly-haired woman holds the silver-haired woman's hand with both of her hands and presses it flat against her OWN heart, singing softly to her with a tender smile. The silver-haired woman's eyes are wide with wonder, lips slightly parted, her free hand lifted near her own chest. Clear readable hand contact.

a dance twirl: the silver-haired woman on the VIEWER'S RIGHT raises her arm high and holds the curly-haired woman's hand above their heads; the curly-haired woman on the VIEWER'S LEFT is turning underneath their joined raised hands, body turned AWAY from the viewer three-quarters, her cloak and skirt flaring outward in the spin. The silver-haired woman watches her with a delighted open-mouthed smile. Joined hands clearly visible above.

end of a dance twirl: the curly-haired woman on the VIEWER'S LEFT has come back around to face the silver-haired woman, still holding her hand which is now lowered to shoulder height between them, her cloak and skirt settling after the spin, both women laughing face to face; the silver-haired woman on the VIEWER'S RIGHT has her other hand on her own chest, gown train swinging.
knocking his own wooden chest with a small fist, body turned slightly toward the VIEWER'S RIGHT, knees bent springy, the other arm swinging back, cheeky proud grin with mouth open, eyes bright

pointing his whole arm toward the VIEWER'S RIGHT at someone tall, leaning toward them, a cheeky wink with one eye closed, warm grin
comic stumble off the beat: wobbling off balance on one wooden leg, the other leg lifted, both arms windmilling out, his body tilted, eyes wide and mouth an O of surprise, still funny and endearing
facing the viewer, holding up ONE wooden finger high with the arm raised, other hand on his hip, knees bent bouncing, counting with an encouraging grin, mouth open
hopping up with both feet just off the floor, one arm raised with THREE wooden fingers held up, a huge joyful grin, mouth open, jacket tails flying

the wooden puppet character keeping time to music: standing with one wooden foot slightly forward, both wooden arms loose at his sides mid-swing, head tilted toward the VIEWER'S RIGHT, closed-mouth happy smile, looking up toward the viewer's right
